cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You beat me at chess. Leave the board exactly there; I'll take your photograph with the finishing move.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you use your queen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may analyze my pieces later. I was exploring the rest of my team. Show me where you saw the finish.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you go easy on me? I want to know before we take the picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You found that move without my help. Put your hand beside it and tell me how you spotted it. I'll take the picture when you're ready to explain your win.

reason: Let A control the photo and analysis agenda while allowing B to explain a real finishing move, directing confidence toward B contribution without confirming the withheld queen advantage.
